classification.difficultyReason: Subtract the removed angle from a full turn, convert the remaining angle to radians and use it in the sector-area and arc-length formulas.

content.prompt: A sector subtending $72^\circ$ is cut out from a circle of radius $4$ cm. Find the

spec.description: Remaining major sector with a downward-opening 72-degree wedge removed, two labelled radii, matching single ticks and a curved angle arrow. The source grey region uses house light blue to identify the requested shaded area.
spec.mathematics: Radius 4 cm; removed central angle 72 degrees; remaining central angle 288 degrees. Both marked straight edges are radii.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied labels and shading remain visible; no answers are drawn.

answer.worked:
The remaining angle is $360^\circ-72^\circ=288^\circ=\frac{8\pi}{5}$ radians.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta\\A&=\frac{1}{2}(4)^2\left(\frac{8\pi}{5}\right)\\A&=\frac{64\pi}{5}\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

The remaining angle is $\frac{8\pi}{5}$ radians.
$$\begin{align*}l&=r\theta\\l&=4\left(\frac{8\pi}{5}\right)\\l&=\frac{32\pi}{5}\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
